respawn.toast.start: Crash {speed} · to the start in {in} s
respawn.toast.sr: Crash at {speed}. The drone comes back by itself. Enter: stay here.
set.crash.enabled.help: Off: hitting a wall only bounces the drone off, the motors keep spinning. On: a hard hit is a crash.
set.respawn.auto.help: On: after a crash the drone comes back by itself, nothing to press. Off: the crash panel waits for you.
set.respawn.delayS.help: How long the crash plays before the drone comes back.
set.respawn.target.help: A few seconds back along your path, or the start.
set.respawn.rewindS.help: Seconds back along your path where the drone reappears: after a crash, when stuck, and with Y.
set.respawn.platform.help: The drone appears on an invisible pad at that height and sits on it, motors on, until you lift off.
set.respawn.keepArmed.help: With the arm switch still on, the drone is armed right after a respawn: no switch flip.
set.respawn.unstuck.help: Upside down or wedged and not moving: the drone goes a few seconds back by itself, like in Liftoff.
set.respawn.showPad.help: Draws a faint ring where the invisible platform is.
set.battery.refill.help: When the pack is full again.
set.battery.refill.opt.start: At the start (R, restart, new scene)
